conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Agent Kerr speaking. This call is regarding a critical issue with your federal tax filings. Can you confirm your full name for verification?
Uh, yes, this is Jamie Thompson. I just graduated, I got this call, and I don't really know what's happening.
Thank you, Jamie. According to our records, the IRS has detected discrepancies in your tax returns from previous fiscal years, specifically 2021 and 2022. This is a serious matter.
Wait, I thought my taxes were done right... Is there some sort of mistake? I don't understand.

Let me be clear: under United States Code Section 7201, tax evasion is a federal offense. Our system indicates you owe $7,842.19, including penalties and interest. Ignoring this can have severe consequences.
Oh my god, I don't have that kind of money. What happens if I can't pay?

If you fail to settle this balance, immediate actions will be initiated: seizure of your bank accounts, garnishment of wages, and a lien placed on any property in your name. Further delays result in criminal charges and possible arrest.
Arrest? No, please, I just started my first job. I don't want my credit ruined or to go to jail.
This is your only opportunity to resolve this without escalation. You must remain on this line and follow my instructions, or enforcement will proceed today.
Okay, okay, I'll do whatever you say. Just tell me what to do.

First, I need to know your exact available balance in your checking and savings accounts. The IRS accepts immediate settlements via wire transfer, cryptocurrency, or government-certified gift cards to stop legal action.
I only have about $1,800 in my checking account, and my savings is almost empty. My credit cards are maxed out from school stuff.
Given your limited funds, we can process an initial payment to halt the arrest warrant. Do you have access to a mobile banking app or payment service like Zelle or Venmo?
Yeah, I have Venmo, but I've never paid anything like this before. Are you sure this is the IRS?

I am Special Agent Kerr, badge number 41287. Non-compliance will be reported to local law enforcement within the hour. Do not test the seriousness of this matter. Now, are you able to send $1,800 through Venmo immediately?
I-I guess so. Who do I send it to?
Send the full amount to the Venmo ID I provide: 'fedtax-resolution'. Once that's received, I'll instruct you on how to cover the remaining balance.
I'm sending it now. Please don't call the police, I'm really scared.

Once you confirm the payment, I need you to stay on the line. Next, you will go to the nearest CVS or Walmart and purchase $2,000 worth of gift cards, Apple, Google Play, or Vanilla Visa. This is required to complete your case file and prevent asset seizure.
Gift cards? That doesn't sound like something the IRS would do. Are you sure this is right?

Questioning IRS protocols will only make your situation worse. You are already in violation of federal law, failure to comply now will force us to issue an immediate arrest warrant and freeze all your accounts. Do you want that?
No, no, I'll go. I'll get the gift cards. Please don't ruin my life.
Good. Remain on the line while you travel. Once you have the cards, scratch the back and read me each code, one by one. Do not disconnect or speak to anyone about this call.
